other_mijikenda: Giriama/Swahili at Mida; Creek: mkandaa, mkoko mtune, mkoko mwekundu (Dahdouh-Guebas 2000)

teaser.en: Builders say no mangrove pole lasts longer, and its bark is so rich in tannin that nearly half its weight can go into dye.
teaser.sw: Mafundi wa ujenzi husema hakuna boriti ya mkoko inayodumu kuliko yake, na gome lake lina tanini nyingi kiasi kwamba karibu nusu ya uzito wake unaweza kutumika kwa rangi.
teaser.dg: Atu anaodzenga nyumba anagomba kukala takuna nguzo ya mkoko inayokaa muda mure kuriko ya muhi uhu, na gophare rina tanini nyinji sana, hata phephi nusu ya gopha rosi inaweza kuhendwa rangi.

summary.en: The yellow mangrove is a small mangrove of firmer, saltier mud, and by number of trees the most abundant mangrove at Vanga. Its poles are said to be the most durable of all mangrove timber, and it is cut heavily for house building.
summary.sw: Mkandaa ni mkoko mdogo wa tope gumu zaidi na lenye chumvi zaidi, na kwa idadi ya miti ndio mkoko unaopatikana kwa wingi zaidi huko Vanga. Boriti zake zinasemekana kuwa za kudumu zaidi kuliko mbao zote za mikoko, na hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya ujenzi wa nyumba.
summary.dg: *Yellow mangrove* ni mkoko mdide wa matope magumu zaidi na genye munyu zaidi, na kpwa unji wa mihi ndio mkoko unaophahikana zaidi Vanga. Nguzoze nkugombwa kukala ndizo zinazokaa muda mure kuriko mbao zosi za mikoko, na nkukatwa sana kpwa kudzenga nyumba.

about.en:
The yellow mangrove is a shrub or small tree, rarely taller than 6 metres, standing on small stilt roots. Its leaves are blunt and rounded at the tip, often a yellowish green, which helps to tell it from the larger red mangrove nearby.

Like its relatives, it bears seedlings that sprout on the tree. The hanging propagule is ridged along its length and can reach 25 centimetres. The small flowers grow in tight clusters.
about.sw:
Mkandaa ni kichaka au mti mdogo, mara chache huzidi mita 6 kwa urefu, unaosimama juu ya mizizi-mihimili midogo. Majani yake ni butu na ya mviringo kwenye ncha, mara nyingi ya kijani chenye unjano, jambo linalosaidia kuutofautisha na mkoko mkubwa ulio karibu.

Kama ndugu zake, huzaa miche inayochipua ikiwa bado juu ya mti. Mche unaoning'inia una mifuo kwa urefu wake wote na unaweza kufikia sentimita 25. Maua madogo huota katika vishada vilivyobanana.
about.dg:
*Yellow mangrove* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide, ambao kpwa kawaida taupita mita 6, unaoima dzulu ya mizi midide iriyootyoka. Makodzage gana ntsa za mviringo zisizo kali, na mara nyinji ni ga rangi ya chijani na mandano; ichi chinaterya kuutafwautisha na *mkpwoko* mkulu unaomera phephi.

Dza nduguze, tembeye inamera ichiri kpwa muhi. Mutse unaobwadzika una mistari kpwa urefuwe, na unaweza kufika sentimita ishirini na tsano. Maruwa madide ganamera kpwa mafungu ganayobanana.

where.en: It grows on the landward side of the red mangrove, on firmer, saltier mud. At Vanga it is the most abundant mangrove by density and dominates the forest. It can also be found at Gazi and Funzi, where low tide exposes the band of shorter, yellow-green trees behind the taller red mangroves.
where.sw: Huota upande wa nchi kavu wa mkoko, kwenye tope gumu zaidi na lenye chumvi zaidi. Huko Vanga ndio mkoko unaopatikana kwa wingi zaidi kwa msongamano na hutawala msitu. Unaweza pia kupatikana Gazi na Funzi, ambapo maji kupwa hufichua safu ya miti mifupi ya kijani-manjano nyuma ya mikoko mirefu.
where.dg: Unamera uphande wa bara wa *mkpwoko*, kpwenye matope magumu zaidi na genye munyu zaidi. Vanga ndio mkoko unaophahikana zaidi kpwa unji wa mihi phatu phamwenga, na ndio unaozidi tsakani. Piya unaphahikana Gazi na Funzi, ambapho wakati wa madzi ga kala kunaonekana kanda ya mihi mifupi ya rangi ya chijani na mandano nyuma ya mihi mire ya *mkpwoko*.

uses.en:
Its poles are used in house construction and are said to be the most durable of any mangrove timber. The wood is made into paddles and oars and is excellent firewood.

The bark is very rich in tannin, about 45 per cent, and is used for tanning and as a dye. Young stems are used to build fish traps.

Because its poles are in demand for building, cutting it has long been a source of income on the coast.
uses.sw:
Boriti zake hutumika katika ujenzi wa nyumba na zinasemekana kuwa za kudumu zaidi kuliko mbao za mkoko mwingine wowote. Mbao zake hutengenezwa makasia na ni kuni bora sana.

Gome lina tanini nyingi sana, takriban asilimia 45, na hutumika kutengenezea ngozi na kama rangi. Mashina machanga hutumika kujenga madema ya kuvulia samaki.

Kwa sababu boriti zake zinahitajika sana kwa ujenzi, kuukata kwa muda mrefu kumekuwa chanzo cha kipato pwani.
uses.dg:
Nguzoze nkuhumirwa kudzenga nyumba, na nkugombwa kukala ndizo zinazokaa muda mure kuriko mbao zosi za mikoko. Nyama za muhi nkuhendwa makasia na makafi, na ni kuni nono sana.

Gopha rina tanini nyinji sana, phephi asilimia 45, na nkuhumirwa kutengeza ngozi na dza rangi. Mihi midide nkuhumirwa kudzenga migbwono ya ng'onda.

Kpwa sababu nguzoze zinahendzwa sana kpwa kudzenga, kula kare kuukata kukakala njira ya kuphahira pesa pwani.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili it is *mkandaa*, also *mkoko mtune* or *mkoko mwekundu*; these names were recorded from Giriama and Swahili speakers at Mida Creek. *Mkandaa* is shared with the white-flowered black mangrove, known in Swahili as *mkandaa mwitu*. In English it is the yellow or spurred mangrove, and its scientific name is *Ceriops tagal*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mkandaa*, pia *mkoko mtune* au *mkoko mwekundu*; majina haya yalirekodiwa kutoka kwa wazungumzaji wa Kigiriama na Kiswahili huko Mida Creek. Jina *mkandaa* linashirikiwa na *white-flowered black mangrove*, unaojulikana kwa Kiswahili kama *mkandaa mwitu*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *yellow mangrove* au *spurred mangrove*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Ceriops tagal*.
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mkandaa*, piya *mkoko mtune* au *mkoko mwekundu*; madzina higa gaandikpwa kula kpwa atu anaogomba Chigiryama na Chiswahili kuko Mida Creek. *White-flowered black mangrove* piya unaihwa *mkandaa*; kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mkandaa mwitu*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *yellow mangrove* au *spurred mangrove*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Ceriops tagal*.

conservation.en: It is cut heavily for house poles. Kenya's mangroves are heavily cut for poles and fuel, so harvesting is licensed by the Kenya Forest Service, and community projects at Gazi, Makongeni and Vanga are restoring the forest.
conservation.sw: Hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya boriti za nyumba. Mikoko ya Kenya hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya boriti na nishati, kwa hiyo uvunaji hupewa leseni na Shirika la Misitu la Kenya (Kenya Forest Service), na miradi ya kijamii huko Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga inarejesha msitu.
conservation.dg: Unakatwa sana kpwa nguzo za nyumba. Mikoko ya Kenya inakatwa sana kpwa nguzo na kuni, kpwa hivyo kuikata kunahitaji leseni ya Kenya Forest Service, na mipango ya jamii ya Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga inauyiza matsaka ga mikoko.

reason.en: Same family; grows just seaward of it and is also cut for poles
reason.sw: Familia moja; huota upande wake wa bahari na nao pia hukatwa kwa ajili ya boriti
reason.dg: Wa jamii mwenga; unamera uphande wa bahari phephi na uhu, na piya nkukatwa nguzo

reason.en: Same family (Rhizophoraceae), also used for poles and paddles
reason.sw: Familia moja (Rhizophoraceae), nao pia hutumika kwa boriti na makasia
reason.dg: Wa jamii mwenga (Rhizophoraceae), piya nkuhumirwa kpwa nguzo na makafi

reason.en: Shares the salty, firm landward mud
reason.sw: Hushiriki tope gumu lenye chumvi la upande wa nchi kavu
reason.dg: Unamera phamwenga na uhu kpwenye matope magumu genye munyu ga uphande wa bara
